title: Finite-free local replacement for cokernel relations
statement: For a ringed space X, a finite type F, coherent G, map f : F ⟶ G, open U, and map g from the rank-n finite free module to (cokernel f).over U, for every x ∈ U there exist an open neighbourhood V of x with V ≤ U, a natural number m, a map ψ from the rank-m finite free module to G.over V, and an epimorphism from kernel ψ onto the restriction of kernel g along V ≤ U. The latter restriction is (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).obj (kernel g), where hVU : V ≤ U.

proof.text: Fix x in U. Apply the local finite-free pullback-cover theorem to obtain V ≤ U containing x and an epi p : O_V^m → P, where P is the pullback of the restricted g and the restricted cokernel projection.

Write gV for restricted g, q for the restricted cokernel projection, and ψ = p followed by the second projection P → G|_V. The square with top ψ, left p, right identity, and bottom P → G|_V is a pushout: its cocone descends by the identity leg, and epi cancellation of p proves the other factorization. Apply Mathlib Abelian.epi_kernel_map_of_isPushout to obtain the induced epi a : kernel ψ → kernel(P → G|_V). The original pullback square gives an isomorphism b from kernel(P → G|_V) to kernel gV, by Mathlib isIso_kernel_map_of_isPullback.

The overMap restriction preserves kernel g: after forgetting modules and evaluating on each object of Over V, its image cone is the evaluated original kernel cone followed by identity restriction of scalars. Evaluation and that restriction preserve the cone, and evaluation jointly reflects limits. The proved private overMap_preserves_kernel supplies this instance. Compose a, b and the inverse of PreservesKernel.iso to obtain e : kernel ψ → overMap(kernel g). Each component is epi, so successive cancellation proves Epi e. Return V, hVU, its point membership, m, ψ and e.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY, proof of (3), cokernel paragraph: same local generator construction, with Mathlib pushout kernel epimorphism and pullback kernel comparison replacing the snake lemma. Restriction comparison and pushout universal property are proved directly in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_cokernel_relations_local (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : F.IsFiniteType) (hG : IsCoherent X G)
    (U : Opens X) (n : ℕ)
    (g : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
      (cokernel f).over U) :
    ∀ x : X, x ∈ U →
      ∃ (V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
        ∃ (m : ℕ)
          (ψ : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over V)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ G.over V),
          ∃ e : kernel ψ ⟶
            (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).obj (kernel g),
            Epi e
